name: Proposition Chunking
mechanism: Uses a language model to rewrite passages into atomic self-contained factual propositions that become fine-grained retrieval units linked to their source spans.
use_when: Queries target atomic facts hidden in dense passages
Fine retrieval granularity is worth higher ingestion cost
avoid_when: Exact source wording and qualifiers must never be rewritten
Claims depend on tables formulas or multi-sentence argument structure
failure_modes: Vector count and ingestion cost multiply
required_evals: vector count cost and citation traceability
